title: Delaware General Corporation Law §§ 141(b), 141(f), 142(a) and 224
source: Delaware Code, Title 8, Chapter 1: § 141 (82 Del. Laws c. 256), § 142 (71 Del. Laws c. 339), § 224 (81 Del. Laws c. 86). Read on delcode.delaware.gov 2026-10-09.

rules.text: One officer records the proceedings of the directors' and stockholders' meetings in a book kept for the purpose; who signs the minutes is for the bylaws.
The board acts only with a quorum (a majority of the directors unless the charter or bylaws say otherwise); the minutes say one was present.
Action without a meeting needs the written consent of every director, filed with the minutes.
Minute books may be kept electronically if they can be printed legibly within a reasonable time.
